high_level_description: The image depicts a serene scene of two individuals on a boat during what appears to be either sunrise or sunset, given the warm hues in the sky. The sky is painted with soft oranges and pinks, reflecting beautifully on the calm water surface. The person in the foreground is wearing a white outfit with black stripes and is seated on the edge of the boat, holding onto a wooden oar. They seem relaxed and are looking down at the water. Another individual, partially visible, is seated behind them, also holding an oar. Both appear to be enjoying a peaceful moment on the water.
